ITEM.PTXT: The 2AZ-FE (2.4L gasoline) engine has been adopted.

The 2AZ-FE engine achieves precise air-fuel ratio control through the optimization of intake camshaft valve timing by adopting VVT-i, the adoption of a 1-valve electronically controlled throttle body, and feedback control combining the A/F sensor and O2Through precise air-fuel ratio control, including feedback control combining sensors, both high performance and high output as well as low fuel consumption and low emissions have been achieved, complying with the "Arial 17 Emission Regulations" and the "Arial 17 Standard Exhaust Emissions 75% Reduction Level (SU-LEV)" under the low emission vehicle certification system, and 2WD models have achieved the "2010 (Arial 22) New Fuel Economy Standard".

"17 Exhaust Gas Regulations": Stricter regulation of CO, HC and NOXemissions specified by Ministry of the Environment notification and Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism ordinance; compared with the "12 Exhaust Gas Regulations", values with NMHC (non-methane hydrocarbons) and NOXemissions reduced by approximately 55% are set as the regulation values. In addition, the exhaust gas regulation values are set according to "10·15+11 mode { (10·15 mode x 0.88) + (11 mode x 0.12) }".

"17 Standard Exhaust Gas 75% Reduction Level": Under the low-emission vehicle certification system of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism ordinance, compared with the "17 Exhaust Gas Regulations", NMHC and NOXemissions must be reduced by approximately 75%.

"2010 (22) New Fuel Economy Standard": A new fuel economy standard based on the "Act on the Rational Use of Energy (Energy Conservation Act)". Gasoline passenger vehicles are required to improve fuel economy by 22.8% or more over the actual fuel economy of fiscal year 7, with 22 as the target year.
